summary: Vaughn Fetzer, 57, of Durango, climbing solo, fell while descending low-fifth-class terrain along Gash Ridge on Blanca Peak’s eastern flank; friends expected him in Tres Piedras, NM the next day and his vehicle was found at the Lily Lake trailhead; Alamosa County Sheriff and AVSAR searched the peak with helicopter and technical climbing teams, then called off the effort; friends located his body on 2021-09-26.
responding_agency: Alamosa County Sheriff’s Office, Alamosa Volunteer Search and Rescue (AVSAR)
notes: Incident date 2021-09-18 (Saturday-verified); body located by friends 2021-09-26 after SAR effort was called off.
